comparator.name: Criminology
comparator.sourceNotes: Current2026–2027 programme explicitly identifies revised first and second years applying from September2025 entrants, each with twelve compulsory5-EC modules:60+60=120 EC. All24 current module responses independently verify credits. Formation items Language Test Criminology, Tutoring/LLP and Leiden Law Practices carry no additional EC. The current third-year group explicitly applies only to entrants2024 or earlier; revised year3 is stated to appear in2027–2028. The outgoing35 required+15 electives+10 thesis cannot be attached to the revised first120. The current programme webpage likewise describes curricular15 EC of electives but links to the older2025–2026 guide and retains outgoing course descriptions; it does not establish the revised-cohort third-year weights or choices. Its30-EC minor suggestion is explicitly EXTRAcurricular and is not counted inside180. Its generic exchange/minor statements do not resolve the applicable revised allocation. Only the verified120 EC are retained; no invented filler, outgoing thesis or elective reduction/addition is used. Required revised third-year courses, bounded choices, elective allocation, final project/thesis and applicable progression rules remain unestablished. No named route or UCR assessment is introduced.

A complete revised-cohort180-EC reconstruction remains unsupported.
